fact: The party advances to 4th level.
source_quote: everyone advanced to 4th level
subject: level up

fact: Daz's Intelligence reaches 19 upon leveling up.
source_quote: Daz's Intelligence reaches 19
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum bumps a score to 19 and defers browsing feats.
source_quote: Gyrgum bumps a score to 19 "at least temporarily" and defers browsing feats
subject: Gyrgum

fact: A ghost with a gruesome cleaved head emerges from the ground.
source_quote: A ghost with a gruesome cleaved head emerged from the ground
subject: ghost

fact: Pelek introduces himself as a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone.
source_quote: He introduced himself with surprising cheerfulness as Pelek, a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek's mother named him after an actor.
source_quote: His mother had named him after an actor
subject: Pelek's mother

fact: Pelek's father never liked Pelek's name.
source_quote: his father never liked it
subject: Pelek's father

fact: Buppido is a derro who was once friends with Pelek.
source_quote: he had once been friends with a derro named Buppido
subject: Buppido

fact: Buppido slaughtered and dismembered Pelek with an axe.
source_quote: Buppido had lured him in with promises of business deals before slaughtering and dismembering him with an axe
subject: Pelek's murder

fact: Buppido became convinced he was the avatar of a major deity.
source_quote: Buppido had changed overnight, going from merely eccentric to utterly convinced he was the avatar of a major deity
subject: Buppido

fact: Pelek has been trapped in the caverns for about a year.
source_quote: The ghost had been trapped in the caverns ever since, which he reckoned was about a year
subject: Pelek

fact: Pelek failed in an attempt to possess Buppido.
source_quote: he had even tried to possess Buppido, and the effort failed entirely
subject: failed possession

fact: Pelek asks the party to collect his bones and bury them in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: He asked the party to collect his specific bones and carry them back to Blingdenstone, where they could be buried in his ancestral home
subject: Pelek's request

fact: Gyrgum wraps Pelek's bones and tucks them into his pack.
source_quote: Gyrgum wrapped them up and tucked them into his pack
subject: bones collected

fact: Thorin fumbles an intimidation attempt against the ghost.
source_quote: Thorin pressed the ghost on what the party got out of the deal and fumbled an intimidation attempt badly
subject: Thorin's intimidation attempt

fact: Pelek laughs off the intimidation attempts by Thorin and Daz.
source_quote: Pelek laughs both off ("You do realize I'm a ghost, right?")
subject: Pelek

fact: Daz is identified as the drow among the party.
source_quote: the drow (Daz) "is not allied with any of the agents of Menzoberranzan, but actually comes from the Overbright"
subject: Daz

fact: Pelek advises the party to state that Daz has no ties to Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: make absolutely clear that the drow among them had no ties to Menzoberranzan
subject: Menzoberranzan

fact: Lolth is a spider goddess to whom Daz must show no devotion.
source_quote: no devotion to the spider goddess Lolth
subject: Lolth

fact: Pelek's severed hand is wearing an obsidian ring.
source_quote: the strange magic pervading the tunnels had animated his severed hand, which had scuttled away through the narrow crevices of the cavern wall, still wearing his obsidian ring
subject: obsidian ring

fact: Pelek's severed hand animated and scuttled away through the cavern wall.
source_quote: the strange magic pervading the tunnels had animated his severed hand, which had scuttled away through the narrow crevices of the cavern wall
subject: severed hand

fact: The ghost encounter takes place in the Whorlstone Tunnels.
source_quote: The skeleton fight in the Whorlstone Tunnels was over
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Pelek is a traveler from Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Pelek, a deep gnome traveler from Blingdenstone
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: The svirfneblin of Blingdenstone know ways to reach the Overbright.
source_quote: the svirfneblin of Blingdenstone "know all these wonderful ways to get to the Overbright"
subject: svirfneblin

fact: Pelek knows of Droki only as a mad derro.
source_quote: Pelek knows of Droki only as the mad derro who comes in and out
subject: Droki

fact: Jimjar is referenced by Pelek as someone who could guide the party to the Overbright.
source_quote: He also notes that Jimjar and many others could guide the party there
subject: Jimjar

fact: The Overbright is a destination reachable via paths known by the svirfneblin.
source_quote: the deep gnomes of Blingdenstone know ways to reach the "Overbright."
subject: Overbright

fact: Pelek's spirit drifts alongside the party as a companion.
source_quote: Pelek's spirit drifted alongside them as a companion, bound to wherever his remains traveled
subject: Pelek bound to party

fact: The session took place on April 28, 2025.
source_quote: Session 2025-04-28
subject: Session Date

fact: The spot where the ghost emerged is marked on the map as Buppido's resting place.
source_quote: The spot is marked on the map as "Buppido's resting place."
subject: Buppido's resting place
